page.layout: One column of verse, centred. Heading "de UB. EM." at top, then three stanzas by the first poet. Then the heading "FRANCISCUS GOMARUS.", a stanza of verse, and the heading "DANIEL HEINSIUS.", followed by Greek verse. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.head: de UB. EM.
main_text.p: HIRCINOS alij folles, plaususque morentur; Præter Monstra, nihil qui didicêre loqui.
Sit, qui CAVLINIS cingat sua pulpita thyrsis; Nil præter SCAVRVM spectet OTACI-LIVS;
Eunus APRO tantum studeat sua scripta probari, Ipse uno hoc visus judice VARRO sibi. Contenti AVGVSTO vos miratore THVANO● Vivite; majus enim quid dare Fata queant?
main_text.head: FRANCISCUS GOMARUS.
main_text.p: Iustus ARISTIDES, doctus PLATO, fidus ACHATES, Eloquio NESTOR, consilioque potens: REX Ponti memoris sit mentis laude superbus, Sic DECIVS patriæ clarus amore suæ. NATHANAEL fraudis expers, pietas SIMEONIS Inclyta, mansuetum SOCRATIS ingenium. Adjice sollicitè varia ornamenta virorum, EMMIUS, in reliquis sparsa, ea cuncta habuit.
main_text.head: DANIEL HEINSIUS.
main_text.p: Ἠχέεις Ἡροδότοιο μελισταγὲς ἱπερόπευμα Ἰαδ[?]ᾳ ἀρχαίης ἐςὶ ἡ ἐυεπίης. Ἐννέα γὰρ Μούσας ὀπηδοφαμένη ζηλὶς αὐτῇ, Αὐτὴ δὴ Μυζίων ἐςὶ μοι ἡ δεκάτη. Αὐτὰρ Θεκυδίδαο βαρὺ ςόμα, τῷ μὲν ἀγῶνες Βίβλος ἅπε μόνον τοῖς τότε γινομένοις.

page.notes: The Greek verse is set in Greek type and is hard to read at this scan size; accents and some letters are doubtful, and the uncertain word is marked [?]. The heading "de UB. EM." is kept as printed. The dot after THVANO is a printed symbol, and is kept. The faint watermark at the lower right corner is not printed text and is left out.
